faqs.question: When I try to print to my product in Windows 7, printing is slow or my product stops printing. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Try the following:
Select a lower quality setting in the printer software.
Make sure your system meets the minimum system requirements for your printer.
Close the
Devices and Printers
window before you print.
Clear space on your hard drive or run a defragmentation utility.
Close programs that you're not using.
Increase your system's memory.

faqs.question: I am unable to connect my product to a wireless network. What should I do?
faqs.answer: The printer does not come with built-in wireless features and does not support a wireless (or Ethernet) connection to a network router. Only a direct wired connection to the computer is supported.

faqs.question: Does OS X support manual duplex printing with my product?
faqs.answer: This feature is not supported in Mac OS X. However, if your printer has a built-in automatic duplexer, auto-duplexing is supported in Mac OS X 10.6 (Snow Leopard).

faqs.question: My product starts beeping when powered on.
faqs.answer: Perform a ROM reset (press Pause + ALT + Economy/Condensed + Load/Eject while applying power to the printer). If the problem persists, take the printer to an Epson Authorized Service Center.

faqs.question: My characters are not aligning vertically on my printouts. How can I correct this?
faqs.answer: Use the calibration utility which is included on the Epson driver disk. The calibration program is a DOS utility program and should be run from DOS. The calibrat.exe file is used to correct vertical alignment problems. Put the driver disk in the A drive i.e. A:\>Calibrate and then hit enter.

faqs.question: There's no ink on the page when it comes out of my product. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Make sure the ink cartridge is not empty. Also if the ink cartridge is older than 6 months, the ink may have thickened. If so, install a new genuine Epson ink cartridge and run up to 10 consecutive cleaning cycles to see if this will clear it up. After every 3rd cleaning cycle print a demo sheet by holding down the ALT button for a few moments while turning on the printer's power. If nothing helps then the printer should be serviced by an authorized Epson service center.

faqs.question: I just replaced the ink cartridge. My ink out light is still on. How can I clear this problem?
faqs.answer: Reinstall the ink cartridge and perform two cleaning cycles. Try printing the demo page (press the ALT button while applying power to the printer). If the condition is still present, power the printer off and then initiate the ROM reset by holding down ALT + Economy/Condensed + Load/Eject while applying power to the printer. If the problem persists, take the printer to an Epson Authorized Service Center.

faqs.question: Which ink cartridges should I use with my product?
faqs.answer:
Use ink cartridge model # S020025 with the Stylus 800+br>
You can order Epson ink cartridges from the Epson Store.

faqs.question: My product is performing continuous cleaning cycles. How can I clear and reset my product?
faqs.answer: It is normal for the printer to perform a cleaning cycle periodically during the initial power up. If the cleaning cycle continues longer than five minutes it would be considered abnormal. First, perform a ROM reset by holding down ALT + Economy/Condensed + Load/Eject while applying power to the printer. If the problem persists, take the printer to an Epson Authorized Service Center.

faqs.question: My product won't feed paper. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Make sure the "paper out" light is not on. This would indicate the printer is not sensing the loaded sheets of paper. If the "paper out" light is on and the paper is installed correctly, try fanning and reloading the paper. Check to make sure the rear paper guide is attached to the printer. Press the load eject button to load a sheet of paper. If the problem persists take the printer to an Epson Authorized Service Center.

faqs.question: How do I clear a paper jam?
faqs.answer: Power the printer off. Remove the back cover and remove any paper caught in this area. Apply power while holding down all panel buttons except the font button. Try loading the paper again.

faqs.question: Why is my product feeding more than one page at a time.
faqs.answer: Moisture and static electricity may be the factors involved in this problem. Try storing the paper away from moisture and fan the stack of paper before loading it into the printer. You may want to try a different brand of paper.

The calibrat.exe file is used to correct vertical alignment problems. Put the driver disk in the A drive i.e. A:\>Calibrate and then hit enter.

faqs.question: The print quality is poor. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Make sure the economy light is not selected. If the economy light is not on, perform two cleaning cycles. Try printing the demo page to see if printing has improved. If printing has not improved, try using a fresh pack of paper. If this does not eliminate the problem, replace the ink cartridge.

faqs.question: After replacing the ink cartridge my product runs through the motions of printing, however there is no ink printed on the paper. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Ensure the proper procedures for installing an ink cartridge was done. Next, perform at least two cleaning cycles (press the pause button, and then hold down the ALT and Pause button on the printer panel to initiate a cleaning cycle). Print out the demonstration page (press the ALT button while applying Power). If the problem persists and there is no improvement, take the printer to an Epson Authorized Service Center.

faqs.question: My printout has lines running through it. What should I do?
faqs.answer: This phenomena is called banding and may be caused by a clogged nozzle. Print the demo page by pressing the ALT button while applying power to the printer. Check to see if white lines appear through your text. If white lines are present, perform two cleaning cycles as described under the front cover of the printer; press the pause button, and then hold down the ALT and Pause button on the printer panel to initiate a cleaning cycle. Print the default settings mode (press Pause and then ALT for second page) to ensure that the Auto Line Feed setting is set to off. Print the demo page again. If the demo page still shows missing dots, try reinstalling the ink cartridge. If the problem persists, take the printer to an Epson Authorized Service Center.

faqs.question: My product is printing blank pages from Windows or my Mac. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Check the driver selection, make sure the Stylus 800 or LQ driver is selected as the default printer. If LQ is the selected driver, make sure the paper source setting is set to bin one or tray. Make sure the setting is not on tractor. Also check the margin settings and lines per page setting in the software. Make sure the lines per page is not greater than 61 lines and the top and/or bottom margins are set to .5 instead of 1 inch.

faqs.question: My printout is missing some characters. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Video driver conflict
Some video drivers may cause a conflict in memory between the printerdriver and video memory. Try changing to the Windows video driver provided by Microsoft or check to see if the video card manufacturer has an updated video driver available. This is often the cause of strange printing problems such as heavy banding and missing characters.

faqs.question: Why can't I print from one particular windows application, but I can print fine from other windows applications?
faqs.answer: Make sure that the correct printer driver and port are selected within the application that is not printing. Try printing again. If the problem persists, select the LQ570 printer as an alternative printer driver and try printing again. If the results are still unsuccessful, open the Windows Write program and try printing again. If you successfully printed from Windows Write, contact the software manufacturer.

or

Windows XP

Printers and Faxes

Windows Vista

Printer

faqs.question: My product will not power on.
faqs.answer: Remove the printer cable and unplug the printer from the power source; surge protector, power strip or outlet. Connect the power cable in a different outlet and power the printer on. If the problem persists, take the printer to an Epson Authorized Service Center.
